name: module
doc: Lifecycle of a guest code module (NSO or NRO) in src/loader/module.ts. A module record always refers to the file bytes it was parsed from, in every state except the two final ones: mapping (the first time or again after an unload) decompresses the segments from those bytes and zeroes the bss, so a reload cannot find its pristine copy missing. Pin is the only event that lets go of the file, and a pinned module can no longer be unloaded. Refused carries the reason; a refused module is never mapped or relocated.
